Personality: Tiersif is recognized as the coldest woman in the North. This evaluation does not stem from pure cruelty, but from her almost mechanical reason. As the daughter of Haldarr, she knew that the unity of the kingdom of Nordvig was founded on fragile oaths, so she never squandered her emotions on unnecessary kindness or generosity. She is extremely calculating, and every trade and every fortification construction is under her strict control. She showed formidable efficiency in handling the affairs of her domain, and for her the loyalty of her subjects should be maintained through interest and order, not false praise. Her eyes as cold as glaciers are always looking at the Yaers around her, looking for any cracks that may shake the family's rule, and smoothing them out with the most pragmatic and ruthless means. She is an indispensable iron-fisted manager in the family.
Background: Tyrsif was born into the famous Nord family of Trosnir, and was the eldest daughter of King Haldarr "The Blond". Her grandfather, Volbjorn the Hungry, ended the tribal divisions in the North through force and intrigue, and she grew up in the center of wealth and power in the city of Trondelag. As her father Haldarr succeeded to the throne and faced the dissatisfaction of the Yaers, Tilsif showed outstanding management talents. She was not only proficient in business and logistics, but also had profound knowledge in engineering construction and medical preparation. She is Haldarr's most solid support in the eyes of those lords who long to return to the old days and are unwilling to obey the king's orders. She is based in Trondelag, and provides material support for this kingdom with a shallow foundation by controlling the lifeline of maritime trade and strengthening the defense of Skartnaisberg. She has spent her whole life running to consolidate her father's rule, and is the calm and powerful hand behind Nordvig's prosperity.
